title: Product Manager
description:
Job Summary Job Title: Product Manager We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Product Manager with 6-8 years of experience in a SaaS product organization. The ideal candidate should possess strong product management expertise, a deep understanding of market dynamics, and the ability to build products that solve real customer problems and drive business growth. The candidate should be a Certified Product Manager with a successful track record of managing the end-to-end product lifecycle, from market research and product strategy to execution and go-to-market initiatives. Experience: 6-8 Years Industry: SaaS / B2B Software Products Employment Type: Full-Time Key Responsibilities Market & Customer Understanding Develop a deep understanding of target customers, market trends, industry dynamics, and competitive offerings. Identify customer pain points, unmet needs, and business opportunities through market research, customer interactions, and data analysis. Act as the voice of the customer and ensure customer needs are reflected in product decisions. Product Strategy & Vision Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives. Translate market insights into product opportunities and innovative solutions. Continuously evaluate market opportunities and recommend product enhancements to strengthen competitive positioning. Product Planning & Execution Own the product roadmap and prioritize features, enhancements, and initiatives based on customer value, business impact, and strategic objectives. Create product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Partner closely with Engineering, UX/UI, and Quality teams to deliver high-quality products and features. Monitor product performance and leverage data-driven insights to improve adoption and customer satisfaction. Go-to-Market & Product Success Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to support product launches and adoption. Develop product positioning, messaging, and value propositions. Enable customer-facing teams with relevant product knowledge and competitive insights. Track product performance metrics and drive initiatives to improve business outcomes. Required Qualifications Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. 6-8 years of Product Management experience in a SaaS or software product company. Certified Product Manager (AIPMM, Product School, or equivalent
